description: Spike fixture for the slot web-IDE runtime. 5x3 lines game, no bonus stage. The same spin carries a single-pass line evaluation (for a `classic` mechanic) AND a cascade-shaped step chain of the same board tumbling (for a `cascade` mechanic) — see script.spin's `data.lines` vs `data.cascade_history`.
note: Not read by e8-server or this task's runtime — --games-dir loads .spin files directly. Descriptive metadata for later IDE tasks (composition screen, symbol legend).
